انفرثوا (form VII)
# اِنْفَرَثُوا (infaraṯū) /in.fa.ra.θuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
# اِنْفَرِثُوا (infariṯū) /in.fa.ri.θuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِنْفَرَثَ (infaraṯa)
